'''Michael Robinson'''<ref name="dt-22596">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22596 LSC 2K2 A tribute to Jedi and their sabers], DeckTech (Michael "Bobafett465" Robinson, 4 April 2002).
